purpose: Replace the visually flat sheet body with physically authored gravity/tension variation while retaining the existing rail-fitted sheet owner, guardrail contact and source material maps.

components: new exposed-face physical stitch-thread geometry at MASTER/LOD0/LOD1 only
manufactureInstallationReasoning.mounting: Existing sheet remains draped over the current front guardrail. Vertices at/above Y=-0.18 m are frozen exactly, so prior rail-contact fit is preserved.
manufactureInstallationReasoning.interfacesGapsSeals: No new interface or seal. Geometry below the frozen contact band receives <=12.16 mm total vertex displacement; stitch geometry stays below the rail-contact region.
manufactureInstallationReasoning.orientationExposure: Y-up. Outer/front hanging face remains the strongly sun-exposed face; inner/back hanging face remains partially sheltered.
manufactureInstallationReasoning.agingCausality: Dry maintained state retained. No stains, rain streaks, wet darkening or UV fade were invented in this refinement.
manufactureInstallationReasoning.geometryVsMaterial: Broad gravity folds, diagonal tension fans, bottom-hem sag and stitch thread are geometry. Fine weave/yarn remains in the source material maps.

authoring.deformation: deterministic broad gravity folds + finer tension ripples + two localized diagonal tension fans + <=8 mm bottom hem sag + <=2.2 mm free-edge captured-shape flutter
authoring.stitching: 0.64 mm diameter physical thread cylinders; same PaleYellowSheet material; omitted at LOD2/LOD3

materialPBR.uvAging: none baked; retained from source dry reference
materialPBR.microstructure: source woven base-color and roughness maps retained byte-for-byte
materialPBR.angularBehavior: dielectric Fresnel behavior expected; no painted/baked highlights added
